S.FORM: alang Ride ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Mansyu go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 167 buwan, 420 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 36% kyan ku 153 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 64% kyan ku 267 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 35%, Amis 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Ride hya' ga Tjadukudukung. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ri*e ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu man[s|ɕ]ju ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** ami[s|ɕ] * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na ri*e ħjaʔ ɣa tja*uku*ukuŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
